entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`rowid` INTEGER NOT NULL, `document_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `book_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `chapter_index` INTEGER NOT NULL, `content` TEXT NOT NULL, `content_hash` TEXT NOT NULL, `search_terms` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`rowid`))

indices.name: index_search_document_document_id
indices.createSql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_search_document_document_id` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`document_id`)

indices.name: index_search_document_book_id_chapter_index
indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_search_document_book_id_chapter_index` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`book_id`, `chapter_index`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`search_terms` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`search_document`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_document_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `search_document` BEGIN DELETE FROM `search_document_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_document_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `search_document` BEGIN DELETE FROM `search_document_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_document_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `search_document` BEGIN INSERT INTO `search_document_fts`(`docid`, `search_terms`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`search_terms`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_document_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `search_document` BEGIN INSERT INTO `search_document_fts`(`docid`, `search_terms`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`search_terms`); END
